parts.text: How high must a salary be in order to be classified as an outlier?

Show that none of the salaries is low enough to be classified as an outlier. 
6 Human blood groups are identified by two parts. The first part is A, B, AB or O and the second part
(the Rhesus part) is + or −. In the UK, 35% of the population are group A+, 8% are B+, 3% are AB+,
37% are O+, 7% are A−, 2% are B−, 1% are AB− and 7% are O−.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
A random sample of 9 people in the UK who are Rhesus + is taken. Find the probability that
fewer than 3 are group O+.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
A random sample of 150 people in the UK is taken. Find the probability that more than 60
people are group A+.
